title: Setting up Recurring Payments | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Setting up Recurring Payments Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046485 This article explains how to configure recurring membership payments, including monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and yearly billing cycles, as well as recurring subscriptions with optional one-time setup fees. Sometimes, admins want to add a one-time payment + a recurring subscription or they might only want a regular subscription. If this is the case, follow these simple steps to set it up correctly: 1. Go to Finance » Membership Plans and click Edit: 2. Then go to the "Sign Ups & Upgrades" tab. Scroll down and add the price of the recurring options: Do the same if need to set up a "One-time setup fee" option + recurring payments. 3. Make sure the "Account type" says "Paid". When the price has been set up, scroll up and click the "Sign Up Page" button: Make sure the price is showing up correctly in the "Checkout" Form: To create one-time payments, read this article: Setting up One Time Payments . If Free Membership Plans need to be created, read this documentation: Setting up Free Membership Plans . If need to edit the amounts displayed on the /join page, read these articles: Side-By-Side Pricing Plans: How To Link Membership Plans To The Price Matrix Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page) For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
